provenance.source_name: Michigan Department of Education / CEPI, MI School Data county reports
provenance.publisher: Michigan Department of Education / Center for Educational Performance and Information (CEPI)
provenance.pending_reason: No src/data/mde-county-<school-year>.csv has been dropped yet. Export the county-level MI School Data reports, add the file with its provenance comment lines, and run scripts/build-mde-county.mjs --apply.
provenance.suppression_rule: MDE suppresses cells under 10 students. Suppressed measures are null and named in `suppressed`; they are never rendered as 0.
provenance.notes: County-level MI School Data report exports are MDE's own tabulations and ship VERIFIED. District and ISD files are deliberately not rolled up to counties (boundaries cross county lines). When status = 'pending-ci' no county export has been dropped yet; the values are null, not zero.

measures.label: Chronically absent students (missed 10%+ of school days)
3rd graders proficient or advanced, M-STEP English language arts
